sources.title: MiniMax-01 release announcement
sources.evidence: January 15, 2025 announcement explicitly releases MiniMax-Text-01 and the separate MiniMax-VL-01, including downloadable complete weights. Names the text model separately from the visual model.

sources.title: MiniMax-Text-01 official model card
sources.evidence: Exact model card discloses nominal 456B total and 45.9B activated per token, 80 layers and top-2 of 32 experts. It describes 1M training context and up to 4M inference context, and documents native function calling.

sources.title: MiniMax-01: Scaling Foundation Models with Lightning Attention
sources.evidence: Sections 2 and 2.4 assign 456B total and 45.9B active to Text-01. Hybrid architecture combines seven linear-attention blocks per softmax block. Section 4.2 distinguishes 1M training from 4M extrapolated retrieval evaluation. Section 6 separately adds a visual encoder for VL-01.

sources.title: MiniMax-Text-01 pinned configuration
sources.evidence: 80 layers; hidden size 6144, expert FFN 9216, 32 experts/top-2; attention layout 70 linear and 10 softmax layers; untied embeddings and vocab 200064. Raw max_position_embeddings=10240000 is larger than the report-validated context.

sources.title: MiniMax Model License
sources.evidence: Custom MiniMax Model License dated January 15, 2025 grants model use, modification and redistribution subject to notice, redistribution and prohibited-use conditions. It is distinct from the repository code MIT license.

sources.title: MiniMax-Text-01 Function Call Guide
sources.evidence: Exact model API and local-generation examples define tools schemas, function-setting input serialization and structured function-call output; confirms native tool calling.

sources.title: MiniMax-Text-01 chat template
sources.evidence: Released template handles text messages and function definitions/results. It contains no dedicated thinking mode or separate reasoning serialization. Its model_max_length=40960000 is a tokenizer setting, not demonstrated model context.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public and ungated at revision a7351bf2bee0e1253919d349f1ad304e6dac13e9. HF metadata reports 456089655296 stored F32/BF16 elements, not used as an exact learned count. A pinned weight-shard bytes 0-7 request returned HTTP 206 and exactly 8 bytes.

sources.title: MiniMax-Text-01 checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Public index contains 8243 tensor keys across 413 shards and no MTP/nextn-named entries. Only metadata/index and an 8-byte access probe were read; no complete tensor census or whole weights download was performed.

sources.title: MiniMax-M1 technical report
sources.evidence: Later first-party report explicitly attributes 456B total and 45.9B active to the preceding MiniMax-Text-01. It describes continued pretraining and cold-start SFT to develop M1 reasoning; M1-specific thinking budgets cannot be assigned to Text-01.

sources.title: Current MiniMax Model Invocation documentation
sources.evidence: Current documentation does not list Text-01. It cannot establish a present native API context limit or current endpoint operation.

name.note: Developer spelling, with the redundant provider suffix removed.

developer.note: Developer-owned announcement and model agreement identify MiniMax.

family.note: Retains the catalog family key; the model belongs to the MiniMax-01 series.

release_date.note: Explicit launch and model-license release date. Repository creation on January12 and paper submission on January14 do not by themselves prove public model availability on those dates.

open_weights.note: Complete weights are publicly indexed and ungated; a bounded shard probe independently confirmed access. Open weights does not imply a permissive software license.

license.note: Named custom weights agreement; MIT applies to code separately.

parameters_b.note: Developer nominal total in billions, corroborated by a later exact-model reference. This is not an exact checkpoint census; the HF aggregate 456.089655296B is not promoted to a learned-parameter total.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer nominal activated parameters per token. The published scalar does not separately specify embedding/output accounting; do not replace it with a tensor-derived convention.

architecture.note: Hybrid linear/softmax-attention MoE: 80 layers, seven Lightning Attention blocks per softmax-attention block; each layer has 32 experts with top-2 routing. Lightning Attention is not a Mamba state-space block.

context_window.note: Developer-advertised inference extrapolation up to 4M tokens, demonstrated on retrieval after 1M training. This is not a verified hosted API limit or a claim of equal performance on all 4M tasks. Raw config 10.24M and tokenizer 40.96M settings are not accepted as capability evidence.

modalities.note: Text-01 is text-only; the separately named VL-01 adds a vision encoder. External MCP media tools do not give Text-01 native visual/audio modalities.

reasoning.note: Dedicated thinking-mode status could not be established from exact-model primary documentation. Ordinary prompted CoT benchmark results do not prove a native reasoning mode; absence of thinking serialization alone does not prove incapability. Clear the unsupported categorical false.

tool_call.note: Exact developer guide and template define native structured function calls and function responses.

description.value: Text-only MoE model combining Lightning Attention and softmax attention, with native function calling and long-context inference.
description.note: Replaces a generic task claim with the exact documented architecture and capabilities.

patch.name: MiniMax-Text-01
patch.description: Text-only MoE model combining Lightning Attention and softmax attention, with native function calling and long-context inference.

sources.label: MiniMax-01: Scaling Foundation Models with Lightning Attention

patch.notes: 456B total and 45.9B active are developer nominal figures, not an exact tensor census. Text-01 combines Lightning Attention with softmax attention and top-2-of-32 expert routing. Reported 4M inference is extrapolation after 1M training, demonstrated on retrieval; the current native API limit is not verified. Configuration/tokenizer maxima are higher but do not establish supported context. Dedicated thinking-mode status is unverified. Text-01 weights use the custom MiniMax Model License; the visual model is the separate VL-01.

summary: Corrects closed-weights status, adds the custom license, nominal 456B/45.9B counts and hybrid-attention MoE architecture, and verifies native function calling and January 15 release. Records 4M inference extrapolation separately from 1M training and unverified current API limits. Clears an unsupported dedicated-reasoning false; ordinary CoT ability is not treated as a native thinking mode.
